verdict.rationale: Docs show plan versioning-like edits (subscription edits without changing the plan, preview impact before saving), audit trail of plan assignments (subscription history preserved), and migration tooling (backfill events, parallel run with Stripe) which support safe pricing changes and grandfathering. However there's no explicit documentation of bulk/cohort migration tools for mass-moving subscribers to new prices—edits are described at the single-subscription level. missing for 10: dedicated bulk/cohort migration API or UI workflow, explicit 'grandfathering' terminology/feature, independent verification of large-scale migrations.
